about_the_game:
Meet Charlotte!

Meet Charlotte — the picture-perfect girl with flawless curls, a sweet smile, and a body made for pleasure. On the outside, she's the high school queen, head cheerleader, polished to perfection... but inside she's a volcano ready to erupt. With her ultra-short skirt, thigh-highs and dainty heels, Charlotte looks like she's stepped straight off a poster for the nation's top colleges. But once the bedroom door closes, that perfect girl turns into a naughty little rebel...

Charlotte longs to completely surrender to her caring Daddy. Her collection includes pink collars, silk restraints and a diary filled with the most detailed, dripping fantasies. She'll blush sweetly, whisper filthy secrets and gaze up at you with wide, obedient eyes... Add Charlotte to your collection and discover just what a good girl can do, once she's finally allowed to be bad!


What You Get?

By purchasing this DLC, you'll unlock Charlotte in her naughty college girl outfit. You can switch mascots anytime by opening your profile in the game and selecting the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
